title: chore: gitignore moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/ (Kotlin daemon session files raise MOE_ATTRIBUTION_UNRESOLVED on landings)
description:
Observed 2026-10-30 at 07:33Z on two landings: V05 (102c9838) and R10d3 (5f4c6873). Each raised `MOE_ATTRIBUTION_UNRESOLVED` for `moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/sessions/kotlin-compiler-<n>.salive`. The Kotlin Gradle plugin writes those transient daemon-session files during every ./gradlew run. `git check-ignore` confirms that neither .gitignore nor moe-jetbrains/.gitignore covers `.kotlin/`, so every landing made during a Gradle build reports them as unattributed paths.

Fix: ignore the directory (e.g. `.kotlin/` in moe-jetbrains/.gitignore, which matches JetBrains' standard Kotlin ignore). Nothing under it is tracked today.
definitionOfDone: `git check-ignore moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/sessions/x.salive` reports the matching ignore rule, and no tracked file is newly ignored: `git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard` prints nothing new.
The change touches only a .gitignore file.

implementationPlan.description:
Edit the root .gitignore, the only file this task touches. moe-jetbrains/.gitignore does not exist, so do not create one.

Add two rules, each under a short comment, and keep every existing line byte-identical:
1. Next to the '# Gradle' block, add `.kotlin/`. The Kotlin Gradle plugin writes daemon-session files under it (moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/sessions/*.salive). Unanchored, it also covers any future Kotlin module. Nothing named .kotlin is tracked.
2. Add `/.serena/`, the human's 2026-10-30 scope addition relayed by governor-693b7073. Serena keeps its local LSP index, project.yml and memories there. They were never committed, and both wrappers already refuse untracked .serena/** at landing. Anchor it to the root, as the human asked.

Use an editing tool and keep the file's line endings. No other file changes. packages/moe-daemon/src/util/initFiles.test.ts only checks that the root .gitignore contains the .moe runtime lines (arrayContaining), so added lines cannot break it.
implementationPlan.note: Added documented root ignore rules for Kotlin daemon session directories and the root Serena local index; preserved existing LF line endings and all prior rules.

implementationPlan.description:
VERIFY ONCE, then a short self-review. This is a config-only change, so no new test file is needed. The DoD checks below are the test.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0; supply its output to complete_task):
git check-ignore -v moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/sessions/x.salive .serena/project.yml && test -z "$(git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard)" && test -z "$(git ls-files -- .serena moe-jetbrains/.kotlin)"

- check-ignore must print one rule line per path. A probe on 2026-10-30 confirmed it matches a nested path that does not exist yet.
- `git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard` printed nothing before this change, so 'nothing new' means it still prints nothing.
- Also run `git status --porcelain -- moe-jetbrains/.kotlin .serena`. It now prints nothing.

Error handling: if check-ignore exits non-zero or lists a tracked file, the rule is wrong. Fix the rule and rerun; never untrack or delete files.

Self-review:
- Does either rule hide a tracked file, or a path the wrappers must still see? .serena is already DENY at landing, and .kotlin holds only transient session files.
- Is the diff only .gitignore, with no reordering?
